extraDisciplines: static-site-only: this is a hand-written HTML/CSS/JS site with a self-contained WebGL2 mesh — no bundler, no WASM, no compile. Hypotheses must respect that; do not propose introducing a build framework.

browser-checks-out-of-annexe: accessibility, performance (Lighthouse), and playwright visual tests need the browsercontainer sidecar, which the HP annexe does NOT have. Never invent a browser evaluator here — record such findings as 'HANDOFF (browser):' notes for a sidecar-equipped run (npm run test:a11y / test:perf locally).
content-is-the-product: copy, messaging, and asset integrity are the surfaces that matter for a marketing site — weight them above code-structure concerns.

estate-health-is-read-not-collected: the nightly estate snapshot (website/static/data/estate-health.json) is collected by CI (.github/workflows/estate-health.yml at 02:30 UTC) and committed as data. A dream night READS it through `node scripts/estate-health.mjs check` and forms hypotheses about persistent reds, stale snapshots or roster drift; it never re-collects, never adds tokens, and never edits the snapshot by hand.

adr-citations-must-exist: cite only ADR ids that exist in docs/adr/; propose new ADRs by title and leave the id to the operator. Reports have cited "ADR-0057" (2026-09-02), "ADR-056" (09-04 and 09-05) and "ADR-2024" (09-07); none of these exist, and the first two are not even this repo's 4-digit scheme. A citation to a record that does not exist is a fabricated authority, and it is worse than no citation because the reader cannot tell the difference.
